summary:
Turn 89 corrected the map's stale top-level unknowns, which still described two surfaces as unread long after they were studied.

What was stale. The target profile's unknowns carried the first version's statements that the client library and the master had not been read. Both were read later in the run and their answers are already used by confirmed findings, so leaving them would have misled the next reader into treating settled contracts as open questions.

Map update (accepted base version 19, one clarified object). The two stale unknowns are replaced by their sourced answers: the client's completion contract (one buffer of the configured command size sent uncapped, each proposal sent once, the reply wait blocking with no timeout or retry, so completion after the admitting replica is lost is owed to a retry the driver does not implement) and the master's leader handling (designation at registration from the configured alias or the lowest ping round-trip, promotion through Replica.BeTheLeader on a dead leader, which is what sets the replica's IsLeader flag). The external-interface entry for the client was likewise updated from "not read this turn" to what was found. The remaining unknown now names the configuration premises that decide whether the delay, durable and transitive-skip paths are active. The map_changes entry carries the client-wait, client-send and master sources with a preserves explanation, so the system boundary, protocol contexts, ownership, selection injection and variants are unchanged.

Frontier. Twelve claim families remain settled — nine confirmed violations or consequences and two bounded no-violation protections, plus the inert documented feature — the map is now current at version 19, two candidates stay paused with scoped resume conditions, one interpretation question remains open for the inert feature, one item cannot be exercised in-package (the reader-side reaction to a displaced stream), and the attribution issue on the superseded C1 artifact stays visible as bookkeeping. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
